setScore(bytes32,string,uint256).details: Writes the score both locally and to the agent's resolver data record.      Only callable by the scorer. The caller must hold `ROLE_SET_DATA` on the      "reputation" key of the agent's name within the resolver.

params.label: The agent's label (e.g. "agent-1").
params.node: The namehash of the agent's ENS name.

RESOLVER().notice: The ENSv2 PermissionedResolver that holds agent records.

SCORER().notice: The address allowed to update scores (the platform's scoring backend).

readScore(bytes32).notice: Read an agent's reputation score from its resolver data record.

scores(bytes32).notice: Aggregate score for each agent node.
